summary: Applied two spec repairs: defined deterministic bare built-in provider-family aliases and removed the dry-run diagnostic conflict.

items.title: Provider-family default behavior is underspecified against ProviderRegistry
items.rationale: The spec now requires Agent default normalization to map bare built-in provider-family keys before ProviderRegistry lookup: codex -> codex/gpt-5.4 and claude -> claude/sonnet.
items.evidence: spec.json scope.in[2], constraints[2], overview.data_flow[2], overview.decisions[2], requirements[2].desc, acceptance_criteria[0], clarifications[1].a, alternatives_considered[2].reason, and T-1 test_strategy now name the alias rule.

items.title: Dry-run diagnostic requirement conflicts with current Agent.call behavior
items.rationale: The spec now preserves _dryRun as a pre-resolution short-circuit and requires diagnostic tests to use unresolved Agent.call without _dryRun or direct resolution seams.
items.evidence: spec.json scope.in[4] now says unresolved Agent.call diagnostics without _dryRun, and tasks[2].test_strategy explicitly preserves _dryRun as a pre-resolution short-circuit.
